content:
Our Commitment to Security, Transparency, and Customer Trust

At MarketJoy, the protection of our systems and customer data is of utmost importance. In our opinion, an organization should be transparent regarding cybersecurity threats when accusations are made by third parties or when public reports are published.

We recently became aware of reports circulating online claiming that MarketJoy was involved in ransomware activity. As an organization committed to cybersecurity, we initiated a thorough investigation to determine whether any security breach had occurred.

This article outlines our investigation process, findings, and the measures we take to protect our systems and customer data.

Our Investigation Process

Once the reports were brought to our attention, the MarketJoy security team initiated a comprehensive review following established incident response and security monitoring procedures.

Our investigation included:

  • Authentication and access log analysis
  • System activity reviews across critical infrastructure
  • Security alert reviews from endpoint and network monitoring systems
  • Security event log analysis for signs of compromise
  • Backup verification and system availability checks
  • User and activity reviews for unauthorized access attempts
  • Data access pattern reviews

The purpose of this investigation was to determine whether any unauthorized access, ransomware activity, or security incident had affected MarketJoy systems.

Investigation Findings

Based on our investigation and the information currently available, we found no evidence of a security breach, ransomware activity, or data exfiltration affecting MarketJoy systems.

  • No compromised systems were identified.
  • No ransomware activity was detected.
  • No customer data exfiltration was detected.
  • No operational disruptions related to the allegations were identified.

While cybersecurity assessments remain an ongoing process and threat intelligence continuously evolves, our investigation found no indication that MarketJoy experienced the alleged compromise.

How MarketJoy Protects Customer Data

Continuous Security Monitoring

Our systems are continuously monitored for suspicious activity, unauthorized access attempts, and indicators of compromise. Security events are reviewed to support timely detection and response.

Access Management Controls

Access to systems and sensitive information is granted only to authorized personnel based on business requirements and the principle of least privilege.

Data Protection Measures

MarketJoy implements security controls designed to protect data throughout its lifecycle and support secure data handling practices.

Infrastructure Security

Our technology environment uses layered security controls designed to reduce risk and strengthen resilience against evolving cyber threats.

Backup and Recovery Strategy

Regular backup procedures are maintained to support business continuity. Backup verification processes help ensure data can be restored when necessary.

Incident Response Readiness

MarketJoy follows a structured incident response framework designed to identify, investigate, contain, and remediate potential security events efficiently.

Why Transparency Matters

Cybersecurity threats and ransomware-related claims are increasingly discussed on public websites and online forums. While such claims may attract attention, they do not automatically indicate that a data breach has occurred.

Responsible cybersecurity practices require validating claims through technical analysis and evidence-based investigations.

At MarketJoy, we believe customers deserve accurate, verified information rather than speculation. That is why we conducted a detailed review before issuing any public statement.

How We Will Continue Monitoring the Situation

Cybersecurity requires continuous vigilance. Following our initial assessment, MarketJoy will continue monitoring systems, security events, and threat intelligence for any information that may require further investigation.

Our ongoing commitments include:

  • Continuous security monitoring
  • Threat intelligence analysis
  • Assessment of indicators of compromise
  • Implementation of necessary security controls
  • Rapid response to security concerns

Our Commitment Going Forward

Trust is earned through transparency, accountability, and consistent action.

Following our review of public statements made by a ransomware group, MarketJoy's investigation found no evidence of a security breach, ransomware deployment, unauthorized access, or data exfiltration.

Although no security threat has been identified, we will continue monitoring the situation closely. If any verified information becomes available, we will communicate openly with our customers, partners, and stakeholders.

We believe cybersecurity communications should always be based on factual evidence. By sharing our findings, we hope to demonstrate our ongoing commitment to security and transparency.

For questions regarding MarketJoy's security practices, privacy commitments, or data protection measures, please contact our team directly.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Did MarketJoy experience a data breach?

No. Our investigation found no evidence of unauthorized access, ransomware activity, or data exfiltration.

2. Why was MarketJoy mentioned in ransomware-related reports?

MarketJoy was referenced in public reports, which prompted us to conduct a thorough security review.

3. How did MarketJoy investigate the claims?

We reviewed system logs, access records, security alerts, backup integrity, and monitoring data to assess any potential risk.

4. Is customer data safe with MarketJoy?

Based on our investigation, there is no evidence that customer data was accessed, compromised, or exfiltrated.

5. Will MarketJoy provide updates if new information emerges?

Yes. We are committed to transparency and will communicate promptly if any verified new information becomes available.
